reply:
Hi,
Order HH-40718, placed 2 September, delivered yesterday: the grey Arlo 3-seat sofa arrived with a 10cm tear along the back of the left cushion (photos attached). I'd like a replacement cushion sent out, and I'm happy for your team to collect the damaged one when it's delivered. Could you confirm the plan by Friday?
Thanks,
Owen Park, 555-0142
note: Reference and date first, the fault factually, one specific ask and a deadline. Asking for the cushion, not the whole sofa, is proportionate and easy to approve.

situation: 今天中午在外卖平台点了168元的烤鸭双人套餐，订单号2026092811438，12:10送到，少了一份鸭架汤和两张饼。12:20和12:35打了两次商家电话都没人接，想在平台上找客服。
reply: 你好，订单号 2026092811438，今天中午12:10送达，168元的烤鸭双人套餐少了鸭架汤和两份薄饼（照片已上传）。我12:20和12:35各打了一次商家电话，都没人接。希望能退还缺失部分的费用，或者补送一份，两个都可以。麻烦今天之内给个答复，谢谢！

I'd rather settle this directly than through a card dispute, and I'm confident we can.
note: If this gets another scripted no, tell them the chargeback date once, then file it.

situation: We had my dad's 70th birthday dinner at Rosalind's on Saturday Sept 26, party of 8, and booked the private room back in August with a $200 deposit. They sat us in the main dining room next to the kitchen door and nobody explained why. The food and servers were lovely. I'm Laura Chen, 555-0187.
reply:
Hi,
We had a party of eight at Rosalind's on Saturday 26 September for my dad's 70th birthday, booked in August with a $200 deposit for the private room (confirmation attached). When we arrived we were seated in the main dining room by the kitchen door, and nobody told us why. The food and our servers were lovely; the room was the thing we'd paid extra for. I'd like the $200 deposit refunded. Could you let me know by Friday 2 October?
Thanks,
Laura Chen, 555-0187
note: Credit what was good in one clause, then ask for the one thing that maps to the failure: the deposit, not the whole bill.

situation: 我叫林晓，9月29日晚上在一家网店买了儿童安全座椅，459元，订单号6120093385。付款时页面显示失败，我又付了一次，结果银行卡被扣了两次，但只有一个订单。想找在线客服把多扣的钱要回来。
reply: 您好，我是林晓，订单号6120093385，9月29日晚上购买的儿童安全座椅，459元。付款时页面显示失败，我又付了一次，结果银行卡被扣了两笔459元，但只生成了这一个订单，两笔扣款记录的截图已附。请把重复扣的459元退回原支付账户。麻烦在10月9日周五前处理并告诉我一声，谢谢。
note: 重复扣款只需要订单号、两笔扣款的截图和一个要求，不用解释情绪，客服照着就能退。

situation: I'm Priya Nair and just checked into the Bellwether Hotel in Boston for 3 nights, out Friday, for a conference with an early start tomorrow. Room 614 reeks of cigarette smoke and I booked non-smoking. Heading down to the front desk now, what do I say?
reply: Hi, I'm Priya Nair, I've just checked into room 614 for three nights, out on Friday. I booked a non-smoking room, and 614 smells strongly of cigarette smoke, enough that I can't sleep in it. I'd like to move to a non-smoking room tonight, ideally within the hour since I have an early start. I'm happy to wait here while you check.
note: In person the same structure works out loud: who you are, the fact, the specific fix and a time, then stay calm and stay at the desk.

situation: I'm Maya Reyes. My language app (Lingora) auto-renewed my annual Plus plan, account maya.reyes@example.com, for $119 on Sept 26. I forgot to cancel, which is on me, and I haven't opened it since June. I want to ask for a refund without pretending it was their fault.
reply:
Hi,
My annual Lingora Plus plan, account maya.reyes@example.com, auto-renewed on 26 September for $119. That's my mistake: I meant to cancel before the renewal and missed it. I haven't used the app since June and haven't opened it since the charge. Could you cancel the plan and refund the $119 as a one-off? I'd be grateful for a reply by Friday 2 October.
Thanks,
Maya Reyes
note: When the slip is partly yours, say so in one line; owning it is what makes a goodwill refund easy to grant.

situation: I'm Daniel Ortiz (555-0163). Returned a $219 pair of hiking boots to Trailhead Outfitters on Sept 4, tracking shows they got them Sept 8. I emailed on Sept 15 and Sept 22 asking where my refund is and got no reply to either. Order TO-88412.
reply:
Hi,
Order TO-88412: I returned the hiking boots on 4 September, and tracking shows you received them on 8 September (screenshot attached). I emailed on 15 and 22 September about the $219 refund and haven't had a reply. Please refund the $219 to my original card. If it hasn't been issued by Friday 9 October, I'll raise a chargeback with my card provider.
Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz, 555-0163
note: After two unanswered emails, stop repeating the ask: name the next step and its date once, then take it if the date passes.

situation: I'm Hannah Weiss (hannah.weiss@example.com). My Skyvale Airways flight from Lisbon to Amsterdam on Sept 18, booking ref K7Q2MD, was cancelled the night before for 'operational reasons'. They rebooked me the next evening, I paid €142 for a hotel near the airport, and I missed a paid day of a conference. I want to claim what I'm owed.
reply: Hello, booking reference K7Q2MD. My flight from Lisbon to Amsterdam on 18 September was cancelled the evening before for operational reasons, and I was rebooked on the next evening's flight. I paid €142 for a hotel near the airport that night (receipt attached). I'm requesting the €400 compensation due under EU Regulation 261/2004 for a cancellation with less than 14 days' notice on a route of this distance, plus reimbursement of the €142 hotel. Please confirm within 14 days. Thank you, Hannah Weiss, hannah.weiss@example.com
note: Check EU261's distance band and whether the airline cites extraordinary circumstances before sending. Leaving out the missed conference day keeps the claim to what the rules clearly cover, which is easiest to approve.

situation: 网上买的空气净化器，订单号8820417736，9月17日签收，商品页面写着“签收15天内出现性能故障可换新”。9月29日开机就报E3故障。客服回复说过了7天无理由，只能寄回厂家维修，要等30天左右。我想要换新，不想吵架。
reply: 您好，谢谢回复。寄修解决不了我的问题：订单号8820417736的空气净化器9月17日签收，9月29日开机报E3故障，签收还不到15天。按商品页面的售后承诺，签收15天内出现性能故障可以换新。麻烦转给主管或售后专员处理，我的要求还是换一台新机。希望10月8日（周四）前能给我答复，我更希望和你们直接解决这件事。
note: 第一次被话术拒绝，只升级一次：重申订单事实、商家自己写的承诺和一个要求，给个期限，不在第一次升级里提差评或投诉平台。法定三包是否适用要看商品类别，发之前可以查一下。

situation: I'm Dana Morales (555-0142). Brightwater Energy sent me a $412 bill for August, marked 'estimated read', set to go out on autopay. My usual bill is about $95. I took a photo of the meter this morning, Tuesday Sept 29, and it reads 18,442. Account number 7710-2294.
reply: Hi, I'm writing about account 7710-2294. My August bill came to $412 on an estimated read; my usual monthly bill is about $95. I photographed the meter this morning, Tuesday September 29, and it reads 18,442 (photo attached). Please reissue the August bill using this actual reading, and hold the $412 autopay until it's corrected. Could you confirm by Friday, October 2? Thanks, Dana Morales, 555-0142
note: An estimated bill is usually fixed by one dated, photographed reading; ask for the reissue, not a discount.

situation: I'm Imogen Hart. My broadband provider Lumenline charged me a £96 early exit fee when I left on 1 September, but page 2 of my contract (account FN-603118) says it ended on 30 June. I emailed, then asked for a manager; today their complaints team sent a 'final response' saying the fee stands and that I can refer it to the Communications Ombudsman.
reply:
Thanks for confirming your position. My contract on account FN-603118 ended on 30 June (page 2 of the contract, attached again), so an early exit fee doesn't apply to my leaving on 1 September. As this is your final response, I'll take the £96 charge to the Communications Ombudsman and reference this thread. If you'd rather settle it directly, a refund to my original card by Friday 9 October would close it on my side.
Kind regards,
Imogen Hart
note: After a final response, stop arguing with the same inbox: name the next step once, leave one clean way to settle, then take it.

situation: My 78-year-old dad, Harold Price, went to the Ashford Street branch of Northgate Bank around 11am on Thursday Sept 24 to update his address. The teller sighed, told him loudly to 'just use the app like everyone else', and didn't help him; he doesn't use the app. He's asked me to write and I'll copy him in. I don't want money, I want an apology and for someone to actually help him.
reply: Hello, I'm writing on behalf of my father, Harold Price, a customer at your Ashford Street branch, with his permission and with him copied in. On Thursday 24 September, around 11am, he went in to update his address; the teller sighed, told him loudly to 'just use the app like everyone else', and did not help him. He is 78 and does not use the app. I'm asking for two things: an apology to him, and an in-branch appointment in October where someone updates his address with him. Could you reply by Tuesday 13 October?
note: When the want is an apology and a fix, say so plainly; it is easier to grant than an open-ended complaint.

situation: My local dry cleaner shrank my wool coat: I dropped it off last Monday, ticket 4471, and the sleeves came back about 5cm shorter. The care label says dry clean only. The cleaning was $18 and the coat cost $320 two years ago. I've used them for years and the owner, Mr. Kim, is usually lovely, so I'm going in tomorrow to talk to him.
reply: Hi Mr. Kim, I've got a problem with my coat and I'm hoping you can help me sort it. I dropped it off last Monday, ticket 4471, and it came back with the sleeves about 5cm shorter; I've brought it and the care label, which says dry clean only. I bought it two years ago for $320. What I'd like is the $18 cleaning refunded and $150 toward a replacement. Is that something you can do?
note: With a local business you want to keep using, the in-person script and a proportionate ask (about half, since the coat is two years old) keep the relationship intact.

situation: 我叫王磊，住滨江花园3栋。网上买了一副699元的降噪耳机，运单号773014288375。物流显示9月28日下午3点16分“已签收，签收人：门卫”，但门卫说那天没代收过我的件，我拍了代收登记本。28日和29日给派件员打了两次电话都没人接，想在快递公司官方客服正式投诉，电话138 0000 0001。
reply: 您好，运单号773014288375，收件人王磊，地址滨江花园3栋。物流显示9月28日下午3点16分“已签收，签收人：门卫”，但我本人没有收到，小区门卫也确认当天没有代收这个件（门卫代收登记的照片已附）。9月28日和29日我两次打派件员电话，都没人接。请帮我核实签收记录和派送照片，把包裹找回；如果找不回，请按商品价值699元理赔。麻烦在10月3日（周六）前给我答复，电话138 0000 0001，谢谢。
note: 先要求核实签收记录，再说清找不回时要什么；能赔多少以运单上的保价条款为准，发之前先看一眼。

situation: Soy Lucía Ferrer (612 345 678). Alquilé un coche en el aeropuerto de Málaga del 19 al 26 de septiembre, contrato MLG-558210. Al devolverlo me cobraron 350 € por un arañazo en el paragolpes trasero que ya estaba cuando lo recogí; tengo tres fotos que hice en el aparcamiento de recogida el 19 a las 10:42. Quiero reclamarlo por escrito.
reply:
Hola:
Contrato MLG-558210, alquiler en el aeropuerto de Málaga del 19 al 26 de septiembre. Al devolver el coche se me cargaron 350 € por un arañazo en el paragolpes trasero. Lucía Ferrer, 612 345 678

reply:

Thanks,
Ana Martins, 555-0178

situation: 我叫陈悦，会员卡号A20417。在小区附近的健身房买了20节私教课，一共3200元，上了8节，教练9月20日离职了。合同第7条写着“教练离职，会员可申请退还剩余课时费”，但前台两次都说只能换教练。我想给门店店长发条正式的消息，要求退剩下12节的钱。
reply: 店长您好，我是会员陈悦，卡号A20417。我在店里购买了20节私教课，共3200元，已上8节，我的教练于9月20日离职。根据合同第7条“教练离职，会员可申请退还剩余课时费”，我申请退还剩余12节的费用，共1920元。前台两次答复只能换教练，所以直接联系您。麻烦在10月9日（周五）前告诉我退款安排，谢谢。
note: 引用合同原文、算好金额、只提一个要求；店长也拒绝的话，再按合同写的投诉途径走。

situation: Ich bin Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@example.com). Ich habe am 3. Juni über die Website von Klangwerk Events zwei Tickets für das Konzert am 17. Oktober in Hamburg gekauft, Bestellung KW-208841, 138 Euro. Das Konzert wurde auf den 6. März verschoben, an dem Tag bin ich im Ausland, und der Veranstalter bietet mir per E-Mail nur einen Gutschein an. Ich möchte mein Geld zurück.
reply: Guten Tag, ich habe am 3. Juni zwei Tickets für das Konzert am 17. Oktober in Hamburg gekauft, Bestellung KW-208841, 138 Euro. Das Konzert wurde auf den 6. März verschoben, und an diesem Tag bin ich im Ausland, kann den neuen Termin also nicht wahrnehmen. Einen Gutschein kann ich deshalb nicht nutzen. Ich bitte um die Erstattung der 138 Euro auf mein ursprüngliches Zahlungsmittel und um eine kurze Bestätigung bis Freitag, 9. Oktober. Vielen Dank, Jonas Weber, jonas.weber@example.com
note: Sachlich den Grund nennen, warum der Gutschein nicht hilft; ob ein Erstattungsanspruch besteht, in den Ticketbedingungen oder bei einer Verbraucherberatung prüfen.

situation: I'm Ruth Adeyemi (ruth.adeyemi@example.com). On 14 September I bought a 65W laptop charger from Amberwick Electronics' website, order AW-771905, $49. Last night it got too hot to touch while charging and scorched the desk under it; I unplugged it and nobody was hurt, and I took photos.

Hello,

I unplugged it straight away and won't be using it again. I'd like a full refund of the $49, and please pass this to whoever handles product safety. Could you confirm by Friday 9 October, and let me know if you want the charger sent back for inspection?
Thanks,
Ruth Adeyemi, ruth.adeyemi@example.com
note: Keep the charger and photos and don't use it again; if a device ever smokes or catches fire, get away from it and call emergency services.

situation: 我叫周敏，9月27日在小区门口的“剪爱”美发店染发，说好染亚麻棕，付了580元。染出来明显偏橙红，发型师小杰说洗几次就会变，现在洗了三次还是橙的，我拍了染前染后的照片。10月10日我要给好朋友当伴娘，想在微信上跟店长提，不想撕破脸。
reply: 店长您好，我是周敏，9月27日在店里找小杰老师染的发，当时说好是亚麻棕，付了580元。染完颜色明显偏橙红，小杰老师说洗几次会变，现在洗了三次还是一样，染前染后的照片发在下面了。10月10日我要当伴娘，希望店里在10月7日（周三）前免费帮我把颜色调回亚麻棕；如果调不了，就退还580元。麻烦10月2日（周五）前回复我可以安排的时间，谢谢！

situation: 我叫刘洋，电话138 0000 0002。报了一家旅行社9月19日到23日的四川五日游，两个人，合同编号ZY-20260911-087。合同附件行程单第2天（9月20日）写明游览黄龙、含门票每人170元，但当天导游说“路况不好”取消了，改去一家玉石店待了两个多小时。行程单和当天的照片我都留着，想给旅行社客服写一封正式的投诉，要回门票钱。
reply: 您好，我是刘洋，合同编号ZY-20260911-087，9月19日至23日四川五日游，两人。合同附件行程单第2天（9月20日）写明游览黄龙、含门票，但当天导游以“路况不好”为由取消，改去了一家玉石店，停留了两个多小时。我申请退还未使用的黄龙门票，每人170元，共340元。请在10月9日（周五）前回复处理方式。行程单和当天的照片我都留着，需要的话随时发给您。谢谢！刘洋，138 0000 0002
note: 只要一件事（门票退款），购物店写成事实就好，不另开战线；对方不回再按升级步骤走。

situation: 我叫张婷，电话138 0000 0003。9月26日坐青岚航空QL8231航班从成都飞昆明，托运的行李箱晚了两天，9月28日才送到酒店，当时在机场柜台办了行李延误登记，编号KMG-QL-04417。这两天我买了换洗衣服和洗漱用品，一共860元，小票都留着，想发邮件给航空公司客服申请报销。
reply: 您好，我是张婷，9月26日乘坐青岚航空QL8231航班从成都飞昆明。我托运的行李箱延误两天，9月28日才送到酒店，当时已在机场柜台办理行李延误登记，编号KMG-QL-04417。这两天我购买了换洗衣服和洗漱用品，共860元，小票照片和登记单已附。申请报销这860元，麻烦在10月16日（周五）前回复处理结果。谢谢！张婷，138 0000 0003

situation: I'm Chris Doyle. I took my car to Kirkby Lane Motors on Monday for front brake pads, and the written job card quotes $380 and says 'call customer before any additional work'. The bill today is $640 because they also replaced the rear rotors, and nobody called me. I'm about to go in and talk to the manager in person.
reply: Hi, I'm Chris Doyle, I'm here to pick up my car and I'm hoping you can help me sort out the bill. Monday's job card quotes $380 for front brake pads and says to call me before any additional work. Today's bill is $640 because the rear rotors were also replaced, and I didn't get a call about it. What I'd like is to pay the $380 I approved. Is that something you can do today?
note: If they refuse, ask for their position in writing and keep the job card; check your local consumer rules before paying or disputing the extra $260.

situation: I'm Nina Shah and I run Little Fern Coffee (nina.shah@example.com). Hi Colin,
Invoice AR-30917, delivered Monday 28 September: all 12kg of the house espresso is stamped 'roasted 31 August' (photos of the labels attached), and our agreement has beans arriving within 7 days of roasting. Nina Shah, Little Fern Coffee, nina.shah@example.com
note: As a business customer, point to the supply agreement rather than taste, and ask for the replacement to ride on the next regular delivery.

situation: I'm Tom Becker. I ordered a $180 desk chair from Oakline Furniture on 2 September, order OL-55102, and it still hasn't arrived. I emailed on 10, 17 and 24 September with no reply, but they answer comments on their Instagram every day, so I want to post a public comment that gets a response without turning into a rant.
reply: Hi Oakline, I ordered a desk chair on 2 September (order OL-55102, $180) and it hasn't arrived. I've emailed three times, on 10, 17 and 24 September, and haven't had a reply. Could someone DM me today so we can sort out delivery or a refund? Thanks, Tom
note: In public, stay factual and keep contact details out of the comment; if it still goes unanswered, a chargeback for the $180 is the next step, so check your card provider's time limits.

situation: I'm Leah Grant (leah.grant@example.com). At Copper Pot restaurant on Friday 25 September I told our server my son Sam (9) has a peanut allergy, and she said the chicken noodles were peanut-free, but they came with peanut sauce. Sam got hives and swelling, we used his auto-injector and he spent the night in A&E; he's fine now. I don't want money, I want the manager to tell me in writing what they'll change.
reply:
Dear Manager,
On Friday 25 September we ate at Copper Pot. I told our server that my son Sam, who is 9, has a peanut allergy, and she told us the chicken noodles were peanut-free. They arrived with peanut sauce. Sam came out in hives and swelling, we used his auto-injector, and he spent the night in A&E; he is fine now. I'm not asking for money. I'd like you to tell me in writing, by Friday 9 October, what will change in how allergy orders are checked.
Thank you,

situation: 我叫孙悦。9月26日到29日把狗狗“可乐”寄养在“汪汪之家”宠物店，三晚共450元。29日接回来发现它左前爪有一道伤口，店员说可能是在笼子里刮的；当天带去宠物医院清创上药，花了260元，有病历、发票和伤口照片。想给店长发微信，要回医药费。
